sourceIdentity.algorithm: SHA256 of sorted UTF-8 path + NUL + lowercase content SHA256 + LF; excludes test-infra/reports to avoid self-reference

parity.meaning: Reviewed feature equivalence with explicit differences; not exact JS behavior or a production security claim.

all-features.scope: Sum of Rust test and doctest result lines; feature runs overlap.

no-default-features.scope: Sum of Rust test and doctest result lines; feature runs overlap.

verification.deterministicRegeneration: passed; no fixture or ledger drift

packages.qualification: Extracted source archive consumer tests; not public-registry publication, packaged test execution, docs.rs or release certification.

ci: The final committed revision must independently pass the eight-job GitHub CI matrix. Inspect the commit-specific Actions run; this local manifest does not assert a future outcome.
limits: No registry upload, name reservation or hosted docs.rs build.
No funded public transactions; mainnet checks were read-only.
Isolated-chain write evidence uses documented patches and public toy keys.
Unmodified funded execution, mature redemption spend and aggregation placement remain unqualified.
Bounded ASAN and deterministic tests do not establish sustained fuzz/reliability or independent security qualification.
Native/worker evidence does not qualify every browser engine or real injected extension.
